resources.title: LEOS - Legislation Editing Open Software
resources.repo_note: MinBZK is a Ministry of the Interior fork describing itself as a proof of concept not meant for production. That is the fork's status, not upstream LEOS's. Upstream is at code.europa.eu and was not retrieved.
resources.format: XML, Akoma Ntoso V3 (OASIS LegalDocML), AKN4EU instantiation
resources.platform: containerized web application; Docker Compose and Kubernetes manifests present
resources.verdict_qualifier: not a drop-in replacement for SemperScribe; not a component of this repository
resources.one_line: Stable EU drafting platform emitting Akoma Ntoso. Models EU legal acts, not naval correspondence. EUPL and containers fail two reuse gates.

reuse_gates.licence: FAIL - EUPL-1.2 copyleft against a 17 U.S.C. 105 target, and no LICENSE exists here yet. Applies to forking into this repository, not to running LEOS as a separate system.
reuse_gates.standalone: FAIL - containerized web application; build.sh must succeed on a fresh clone
reuse_gates.scale: FAIL - drafting platform against a static-site encoding project
reuse_gates.substitution: PARTIAL - would replace SemperScribe, not repository code
reuse_gates.exit: PASS - stable, actively released, EU institutional maintainer

resources.argument_for: Akoma Ntoso output satisfies INTEGRATION-SEMPERSCRIBE.md requirement R2 by construction, removing the largest unknown in that design and replacing a proprietary NLDP with an OASIS standard interface.
resources.argument_against: Models EU legislative instruments in AKN4EU. A Marine Corps Order under MCO 5215.1K - Situation, Mission, Execution, Cancellation - is not one of those. Teaching it means maintaining a fork of an EUPL web application.
decision_tree: 1. Ask whether SemperScribe meets R2, structured provisions with native designators. One conversation.
2. If yes, build the Option A bridge and this question closes.
3. If no, evaluate LEOS as a SEPARATE system emitting AKN, never as a fork inside this repository.
4. Either way, require structured XML export with native designators, and prefer AKN over a private format.
unconfirmed: Full technical prerequisites - language, framework, repository backend. The fork exposes only Dockerfiles and shell; upstream at code.europa.eu was not retrieved.
The AKN4EU versus MCO 5215.1K structural mismatch is a reasoned conclusion from both models, not a quoted statement.

resources.title: SUMO, Suggested Upper Merged Ontology, and the Ontology Portal
resources.format: SUO-KIF, first-order logic with higher-order extension. Exports to TPTP, OWL, and Neo4j.
resources.license: CONTRADICTORY. ontologyportal.org states SUMO is free and owned by the IEEE with extensions under GPL. The GitHub repository header states GNU Public License over a repository holding both.
resources.verdict_qualifier: Extends EVALUATE past row 24, which the 2026-08-08 pass restricted it to. Deliberate, recorded in resources/README.md.
resources.one_line: A world model with a prover behind it, complementing rather than competing with LegalRuleML. Licensing unresolved, and the corpus's live problem is provenance, not inference.
argument_for: LegalRuleML, named in conformance-matrix.md section 13 as the closest fit, carries deontic operators and no model of the world the rules quantify over. SUMO is the opposite shape.
Law.kif defines permits, prohibits, confersRight, confersObligation, confersNorm, deprivesNorm, holdsRight, and holdsObligation.
A theorem prover stands behind it, which no other register entry offers.
argument_against: The live problem is provenance. 85 drift findings and 220 references to documents never held are a collection problem, not an inference problem.
conformance-matrix.md section 12 already ruled this question for OWL and Protege. Correct tool, not yet needed. Reversing it for a heavier formalism needs more evidence, not less.
SUO-KIF is outside every interchange path the consumers read, which is NIEM, USLM, DCAT, and OWL or RDF. The OWL export is lossy against the axioms, which are the point.
Law.kif is 507 lines and defines no statute, regulation, or jurisdiction primitive.
resources.decision_tree: Does data/*.rules.json need cross-document consistency checking, and does that check require a model of the entities the rules quantify over. Trigger: when rules.json generalizes past parental leave to two or more interacting orders. Then evaluate SUMO plus Sigma against LegalRuleML plus SHACL on one worked example, and decide once.
unconfirmed: IEEE ownership of SUMO. No standard number confirmed this pass. The claim traces to the former IEEE Standard Upper Ontology working group.

No independent, third-party assessment of SUMO is held in this register. Every source in this pass traces to one author. One independent evaluation is required before adoption, with BFO under ISO/IEC 21838-2 as the comparison baseline.

addenda.summary: Method read from 78 retrieved papers. Verdict unchanged. Deontic layer experimental; no paper computes an entitlement quantity; English-to-logic output 59-62% well-formed on policy text with meaning unmeasured; no license named in any paper.
